purpose: test on an unseen public cohort whether buyers of resolved Polymarket sports Combo YES positions systematically paid more than realized payout and whether the opposite-side gross spread proxy is stable enough to justify exact market-maker quote economics research

discovery_boundary_already_observed.warning: the discovery wallet-presence screen used the endpoint default status set and therefore preferentially found wallets with open or losing positions; discovery economics cannot satisfy any gate
discovery_boundary_already_observed.corrective_rule: all validation position requests must explicitly request RESOLVED_WIN,RESOLVED_PARTIAL,RESOLVED_LOSS together

unseen_validation_cohort.exclude_wallets: every wallet returned by the frozen discovery query at offsets 0 through 200 in either orderBy cohort
unseen_validation_cohort.wallet_assignment: PNL when present in the validation PNL pages otherwise VOL_only
unseen_validation_cohort.reason: current Builder requester flow quotes Combo YES; NO rows can be maker inventory or residual positions and are not an unbiased requester-return sample

economics.seller_proxy_limit: the proxy omits seller fees hedging collateral funding capital return latency Last Look decline and quote competition and therefore cannot establish executable maker profit
economics.partial_resolution_handling: use the exact realized_payout_usdc reported by the source

decision_boundary.pass: retain_as_high_priority_unaccepted_combo_market_maker_overround_candidate_and_require approved maker access exact quote logs seller net receive hedges collateral return capital occupancy and forward paper evidence before promotion
decision_boundary.fail: terminalize broad public sports Combo buyer-overround inference and do not repeat leaderboard mining without a materially less selected population or direct maker quote ledger
decision_boundary.all_outcomes: no authenticated request quote acceptance trade transfer profitability claim or deployment authority

raw_retention.repository_projection: compact gzip CSV of only fields used by the adjudication
